scope: Read-only acceptance review of the shared framework and current uncommitted implementation. No production or test files were changed by this review.
result: No new confirmed production blocker found in the audited invariants.

invariants.qualification: Normal shuffled-bag cycles avoid adjacent mode and entry repeats when alternatives exist. During fault recovery a previously verified fallback may repeat; the intentional first → first → last case is not a promise of zero recovery repeats. Failed candidates cannot indefinitely starve healthy modes or entries.

additionalReadOnlyProbes.name: Same-level variants and cycle boundaries across seeded randomness
additionalReadOnlyProbes.method: Imported createDemoRotation in an inline Node process; used 200 seeds, ninety performances per seed, three modes, two variants of the same level and seventeen duplicate recordings for one variant.
additionalReadOnlyProbes.result: Passed: each normal mode cycle and each per-mode level/variant cycle was balanced; no adjacent mode or entry repetition across normal cycle boundaries.

additionalReadOnlyProbes.name: Late adapters after the overall recovery budget
additionalReadOnlyProbes.method: Used the existing controlled loading clock with two pending preparations; expired the overall budget at thirty seconds, then resolved both abandoned adapters.
additionalReadOnlyProbes.result: Passed: both adapters disposed exactly once, phase remained unavailable, no player revived, no loading timers remained.

additionalReadOnlyProbes.name: Cleanup that does not finish before its admission deadline
additionalReadOnlyProbes.method: Held the current player's disposal promise, requested Next, and advanced the existing controlled clock by five seconds before releasing cleanup.
additionalReadOnlyProbes.result: Passed: replacement preparation never began, phase became unavailable at the cleanup deadline, and no loading timers remained.

suiteStatusAtReview.affectedSuite: 713 tests: 708 passed and five known failures. The stale paused-picture explanation was fixed; hidden-readout and restored-origin expectations were corrected.
suiteStatusAtReview.focusedRerun: All twenty-six tests passed in .cache/demo-final-host-regressions.log, covering all five known failures plus related host behavior.
suiteStatusAtReview.nextGate: Rerun the complete affected suite after the separate shared-settings change; this review does not claim that rerun has passed.

limitations: Exact line references describe the review snapshot and may shift after subsequent edits.
The inline probes produced passing process output but were not added as durable executable test cases.
This review does not replace full catalog qualification, final packaging, or a completed two-hour actual-browser rotation.
Firefox/WebKit mixed receipts cover their recorded interaction checks; their lifecycle flag does not establish Chromium-only CDP freeze/resume behavior.
Resource counters cover observable owned handles, scenes and listeners; they do not prove operating-system thread exit or measure all browser/GPU memory.
Physical-controller/radio, real mobile, audible-output and unfamiliar-player comprehension checks remain pending human/device review.
